_meta.hard_truth: This is a premium gift and modest lifestyle boutique; the hero product is a curated gift box; all scenes PUBLIC; no alcohol props; no skin display; modest fashion is fully covered — abaya, shawls, scarves.
_meta.signature_serving_system: Rigid matte black or dusty-rose gift boxes with satin ribbon. Tissue paper and branded sticker seal. Products shown on clean white marble or oak display surfaces. Tags with handwritten Arabic calligraphy.

صندوق هدايا راقية.identity_dna: A rigid matte gift box — deep forest-green or blush rose — dressed in a velvet satin ribbon and a wax-sealed branded sticker. Inside: curated items in tissue paper layers, each wrapped individually. The box exterior is clean, weight-forward, and premium without being ostentatious. The moment of opening is the product: layers of tissue reveal surprises.
components: rigid matte gift box (forest green or blush rose)
صندوق هدايا راقية.signature: A weighted matte box tied with a velvet ribbon — premium without flash, thoughtful by design
صندوق هدايا راقية.texture: Smooth matte board exterior; soft satin ribbon; crisp tissue inside; ribbon curls under fingertip

عطر عود فاخر.identity_dna: A Saudi oud-based perfume oil in a hand-blown amber glass vial or polished wooden box, stoppered with a gold or brass cap. Deep, smoky resinous oud layered with rose, amber, and musk — the signature Saudi luxury fragrance. The vial is weighty; the amber glass glows under warm light.
components: amber glass or polished wood vial
عطر عود فاخر.signature: Amber glass vial, heavy in hand, glowing under warm light — the most personal luxury you can gift a Saudi
عطر عود فاخر.texture: Oil-heavy, warm, resinous; vial is cool and weighty glass; the scent trail is thick and long-lasting

سبحة مرمر وعقيق.identity_dna: A handcrafted prayer beads set (سبحة) — 99 white marble beads with deep red agate (عقيق يمني) spacers, hand-knotted on silk thread, with a silver tassel finisher. Presented in a velvet-lined wooden box. The beads are cool and smooth to the touch; the red agate catches light. A deeply personal spiritual gift.
سبحة مرمر وعقيق.signature: Cool smooth marble prayer beads with red agate accents on silk thread — presented in a velvet wooden box
سبحة مرمر وعقيق.texture: Cool polished marble; smooth, satisfying weight in the palm; silk thread fine and soft between fingers

شال كشميري محتشم.identity_dna: A pure cashmere shawl in a muted palette — warm camel, dusty rose, or sage green — woven in a subtle herringbone or diamond pattern, with hand-knotted fringe at both ends. Generous dimensions (2m × 0.7m); drapes softly. Packaged in a tissue-nested box with a ribbon. The softness is the first thing felt when lifted.
components: muted tonal palette (camel / dusty rose / sage)
شال كشميري محتشم.signature: Feather-light cashmere shawl in muted Saudi-safe palette — draped or folded, it reads instant luxury
شال كشميري محتشم.texture: Whisper-soft, cloud-light cashmere; almost weightless drape; fringe is fine and silky at the edges

مجموعة بطاقات تهنئة خطية.identity_dna: A curated set of 6 premium greeting cards — each with an original Arabic calligraphy design on cream cotton-stock paper, blank inside for personal message. Packed in a linen-wrapped box. The calligraphy uses a classic Diwani hand or contemporary thuluth style. Each card has a different occasion (Eid, wedding, graduation, new home, congratulations, general).
components: Arabic calligraphy design per card (Diwani / Thuluth)
مجموعة بطاقات تهنئة خطية.signature: Six Arabic calligraphy cards on cream cotton paper — for the six big moments of a Saudi life
مجموعة بطاقات تهنئة خطية.texture: Slightly textured cotton stock; edges deckled and soft; calligraphy embossed or letterpress-printed; envelopes have a crisp tuck

شموع عطرية عربية.identity_dna: A set of 3 hand-poured soy-wax candles in ceramic vessels — each scented with a distinct Arabic fragrance note: oud & amber, rose & musk, and bakhoor & sandalwood. The vessels are matte cream ceramic with a debossed Arabic brand name. Presented in a matte box with tissue. Burn time 40h each.
components: three Arabic fragrance variants (oud+amber / rose+musk / bakhoor+sandalwood)
شموع عطرية عربية.signature: Three matte cream ceramic candles in Arabic fragrance notes — a sensory gift that fills the home with KSA
شموع عطرية عربية.texture: Matte smooth ceramic vessel; candle wax surface is flat and slightly waxy-matte until lit; flame is clean and steady

دفتر جلد طبيعي.identity_dna: A hand-stitched genuine leather journal in deep cognac or midnight blue — A5 format, 200 pages of thick ivory laid paper, sewn binding that opens flat. Interior pages have a subtle gold-ruled line. The leather cover develops a patina with use. Embossed with a small geometric Arabic pattern on the front cover.
components: genuine leather cover (cognac or midnight blue)
Arabic geometric emboss on front cover
دفتر جلد طبيعي.signature: Cognac leather journal that opens flat — every page a blank invitation, the cover age-worthy from first use
دفتر جلد طبيعي.texture: Supple leather that warms to the hand; pages are thick and cream, slightly textured; spine cracks softly when opened

طقم قهوة خزف يدوي.identity_dna: A hand-thrown ceramic coffee set for two — one small dallah-inspired pourover pot and two handleless finjan cups in a matte sand or sage glaze, each piece hand-thrown and unique. The glazes are food-safe; the forms reference traditional Gulf coffee ware. Presented in a wooden tray with a linen cloth. The imperfect character of handmade ceramic is the feature, not a flaw.
طقم قهوة خزف يدوي.signature: Two handleless finjan cups and a dallah-shaped pot in handmade ceramic — the Gulf coffee ritual made beautiful
طقم قهوة خزف يدوي.texture: Matte ceramic that is cool and slightly rough to touch; walls are thin and ring when tapped; glaze has subtle drip variation per piece
